parse.title: Chaos Temple (hut)
parse.wikitext:
==Transportation==
* Teleport via use of a [[burning amulet]]'s teleport to [[Lava Maze]] entrance and run south-west (be wary of player killers)
* Teleport via [[Ghorrock Teleport]] (Level 96 Magic) on [[Ancient Magicks]] and run south
* Teleport via [[Cemetery Teleport]] (Level 71 Magic) on the [[Arceuus spellbook]] and run north
* Players who have an [[Obelisk (Construction)|Obelisk]] in their [[player-owned house]] can use it to teleport to level 44 Wilderness and then run south
* If [[Wilderness Diary|Hard Wilderness Diary]] is complete, any Obelisk can be used to teleport to level 44 Wilderness and then run south
